title: Double It
story: Hole 1 of the Shrine. Shortest code wins. Par is the tidy version; a birdie beats it.
goal: Write double(x) returning twice x, using as few characters as you can.
hints: return x * 2 is the tidy way.
A lambda can replace def and return: double = lambda x: x*2
socratic: What is the plainest way to do it?
Which words or spaces can disappear?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Double It”?
